title: Video showing Higher Education Minister touching girl athletes’ legs sparks outrage
summary: Video captures him touching outstretched legs of athletes and cracking their toes while another guest was seen shaking hands with them; a complaint has been lodged at the DGP’s office against the Minister by lawyer Saranya Natarajan of the DMK’s Legal wing.
